subject: US Attorney calls out 'loud-mouth' California Dems as feds step in with Skid Row drug bust
posts:
Federal crackdowns on Skid Row expose deep partisan divides over criminal justice.
Evidence: Federal arrests, political rhetoric, local pushback
#Aletheia #USPol

Federal prosecutors claim lenient state laws and progressive politicians created open-air drug markets and crime.
Stated Judgement: (+0.5, 0.0) — Good Preference

While federal ops target gang networks, politicians use human misery for partisan point-scoring and theater.
Resulting Judgement: (-0.7, -0.6) — Lesser Evil

Verdict: FAIL — The Path of Deception.
Political actors exploit real crime and human tragedy to trade tribal blows rather than build lasting systemic solutions.

Integrity: Meaningful Distortion (Hypocrisy: 7.5, z: 4)

- US Attorney Presser: COND (0.5, 0.0) — Highlights real drug crisis but frames it entirely as partisan blame.
- AOC Statement: FAIL (-0.8, -0.9) — Demands policy halt while ignoring violent gang charges.
Federal law enforcement executed 'Operation Save Skid Row' in Los Angeles while political leaders exchanged sharp attacks over criminal justice laws and immigration enforcement.

The Bright Side:
Multi-agency coordination successfully arrested 28 suspects and disrupted dangerous gang-linked drug distribution networks in downtown Los Angeles.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
Confusing political rhetoric (WHO) with systemic crime reduction (WHAT). Blaming state politicians does not instantly solve open-air addiction.

Social Physics Analysis:
Federal prosecutors and politicians run a Smart Selfish Maneuver, using real human misery on Skid Row as a pretext to attack political opponents while avoiding root systemic failures in housing and mental health care.

The Trajectory: The Path of Deception.
When you map the gap between stated intentions and ground-level results, it plots a direct trajectory toward Lesser Evil. Antagonistic rhetoric replaces institutional reform.

The Unavoidable Truth: Law enforcement actions can temporarily clear open-air markets but cannot resolve structural addiction without deep systemic care.

The Unavoidable Lie: Partisan posturing by politicians will fix urban crime and homelessness.

Alethekanon:
Institutions weaponize real tragedies as political ammunition, substituting fiery press conferences for genuine structural repair.

Awwthekanon:
Behind every political shouting match and police raid are vulnerable human beings trapped in cycles of addiction and despair who deserve real healing, not tribal theater.

Brothekanon:
Just another day of politicians yelling at each other on TV while the actual problems on the street stay exactly the same.

Spirithekanon:
"Where there is no guidance, a nation falls, but in an abundance of counselors there is safety." Proverbs 11:14 FAIL
Politicians trade insults on TV instead of seeking wise counsel.

US Attorney calls out 'loud-mouth' California Dems as feds step in with Skid Row drug bust: 'They're lunatics'

First Assistant U.S. Attorney Bill Essayli blasted California Democrats for watering down criminal law after feds led a massive Skid Row crackdown.

Actual Article Body:

Assistant U.S. Attorney Bill Essayli called out California Democrats for watering down the state's criminal law after federal law enforcement led the charge on a drug crackdown in the infamous Skid Row neighborhood on Thursday.

First Assistant U.S. Attorney Bill Essayli called out California Democrats for watering down the state's criminal law after federal law enforcement led the charge on a massive drug crackdown in the infamous Skid Row neighborhood on Thursday.

Essayli told Fox News Digital in an interview that California's state and local law enforcement have worked with feds just fine, but that it's the politicians who are getting in the way.

"Unfortunately, states like California have totally watered down their laws, their criminal justice laws. They've also emptied their prisons and closed prisons, so effectively, there's not much of a deterrence on the state side. No one faces any serious consequences on the state side," Essayli said.

NEWSOM BLASTED BY SHERIFF IN HIS OWN BACKYARD OVER CALIFORNIA CRIME AS VICTIMS CRY FOUL

First Assistant U.S. Attorney for the Central District of California Bill Essayli answers questions during a news conference outside the San Bernardino County Sheriff's Department in Rancho Cucamonga on Friday, April 10, 2026. (Anjali Sharif-Paul, The Sun/SCNG)

"We work really well with our local law enforcement partners," he continued. "Local law enforcement isn't the problem. It's more the governor, it's the legislature, it's these loud-mouth federal, you know, Congress members who all they care about is attacking the administration, attacking the president."

Essayli did give credit to Mayor Karen Bass for approving the Los Angeles Police Department to participate in Thursday's Operation Save Skid Row.

KAREN BASS GRILLED OVER BROKEN HOMELESSNESS PROMISE, BLAMES BUREAUCRACY FOR SLOWED PROGRESS

"This is a climate in which you have people right now trying to defund the police. You have people trying to disarm the LAPD, and those people are on the side of criminals," he added. "Anyone who's calling for disarming the police is on the side of the drug dealers that we arrested today, they're lunatics."

Law enforcement officers look at encampments that had been taped off in Skid Row on Thursday, Oct. 8, 2026 in Los Angeles. Federal law enforcement officials, along with the Los Angeles Police Department, are targeting drug dealing in Downtown Los Angeles with "Operation Save Skid Row." (Eric Thayer / Los Angeles Times via Getty Images)

Operation Save Skid Row saw federal and city authorities execute 28 arrest warrants and 44 search warrants in an effort to dismantle drug distribution networks in the notorious neighborhood.

TALARICO PUT ON DEFENSE AFTER 2020 COMMENTS ABOUT DEFUNDING POLICE RESURFACE: 'WE MUST REPLACE'

Over 100 law enforcement vehicles were involved in the operation, with arrests targeting members of multiple gangs, including the "Main Street Crips," "Grape Street/Raymond Avenue Crips" and the "Pueblo Bishop Bloods."

City workers clear encampments in Skid Row on Thursday, Oct. 8, 2026, in Los Angeles. (Eric Thayer / Los Angeles Times via Getty Images)

CLICK HERE TO DOWNLOAD THE FOX NEWS APP

"We are no longer going to have open-air drug markets in the United States, let alone on Skid Row. And that is the reason you see so many homeless people who are experiencing psychotic episodes, who are unwell, they aren't seeking help, it's because you have people, like the drug dealers we are arresting today, keeping them addicted and taking their public assistance money to pay for their drugs," Essayli said during a news conference on Thursday.

AOC calls for ‘full and independent investigation’ into Bronx ICE shooting — while blaming Target for aiding feds

New York Congresswoman Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez is demanding a “full and independent investigation” into the ICE shooting of a suspected illegal-migrant gang member in the Bronx — and blasted Target for assisting federal immigration officers.

Actual Article Body:
Switch between CA and NY editions here.

See more of our coverage in your search results.

New York Congresswoman Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez is demanding a “full and independent investigation” into the ICE shooting of a suspected illegal-migrant gang member in the Bronx — and blasted Target for assisting federal immigration officers.

AOC lashed out as protesters took to the streets over the shooting of the suspected Trinitarios member shot in the neck in his car by federal agents in Marble Hill Thursday afternoon while a 5-year-old boy, believed to be his son, sat in the backseat.

“ICE’s already unwelcome presence in our city has been growing more escalatory and dangerous by the day. Today’s shooting is a grave development that requires a swift and immediate response to protect the safety of all New Yorkers,” she said in a statement Thursday night.

“First, we must have a full and independent investigation of this incident,” followed by a “full and immediate release of all body camera footage of the incident,” she said.

The democratic socialist also accused retail giant Target of assisting ICE agents.

“In addition, the Target Corporation must stop offering their Bronx properties as private staging sites for ICE, in compliance with requests from New York officials,” she said.

“Target opening up large, active retail parking lots for paramilitary activity is unacceptable and places the entire community at risk.”There is a Target store and parking lot about half a mile from where the shooting occurred.

“ICE is a rogue, lawless paramilitary and surveillance agency,” the congresswoman raged. “It does not belong in New York City and it should not exist in the United States of America. Abolish ICE.”

The 28-year-old migrant was identified by the NYPD as Oscar Belgal, whom the DHS alleged has ties to the Trinitarios gang.

He was shot around 4:20 p.m. on Marble Hill Avenue as federal agents attempted to take him into custody.

He is expected to survive and was taken to NewYork-Presbyterian Allen Hospital for treatment before he was later whisked away in an unmarked ICE vehicle late Thursday night, officials said.

The young boy, who has not been identified but is believed to be Belgal’s son, was not injured.

Belgal has previous convictions for grand larceny, and multiple prior arrests for assault, robbery, possession of drugs, and weapons possession, according to the Department of Homeland Security.

The feds were investigating whether the wounded man is tied to the migrant moped gang that shot an off-duty border patrol agent at Fort Washington Park last year, sources said.

Mayor Zohran Mamdani said he tried to negotiate with President Trump to have Belgal released while calling for ICE to be abolished.

“This is an unconscionable and incredibly serious situation. I have called the President; when we speak I will demand that he ends all ICE enforcement actions in our city. I will not stand by while ICE agents terrorize our communities,” Hizzoner said.
